# IMMUNIZATION OF PREGNANT PATIENTS

Pregnant women should receive the tetanus, diphtheria, and acellular pertussis vaccine (Tdap) during pregnancy and the influenza vaccine during or before pregnancy. Live vaccines are contraindicated (e.g. MMR and Varicella). See immunization information pages located at the bottom of this page for other indications, contraindications, and one-time dose orders to listed vaccines.

CDC Recommended Adult Immunization Schedule

# Specific vaccine orders for pregnant patients:

[Haemophilus influenza type b: indicated in asplenia, those undergoing](haemophilus-influenza-type-b-vaccine-information)
splenectomy and HSCT patients. Refer to specific immunization recommendations for patients with these indications or refer to the Haemophilus influenza type b vaccine information menu below.

Hepatitis A: if at risk for infection or severe outcome from infection during
pregnancy.

Hepatitis A/B: if at risk for infection or severe outcome from infection during
pregnancy.

Hepatitis B: 3 dose series.
Hepatitis B high dose: 4 dose series, for those on hemodyalisis.

[Zoster \(shingles\) Information Page](zoster-vaccine-information)

Herpes zoster: delay until after pregnancy unless at increased risk and information menu below.

Human papillomavirus: *CONTRAINDICATED*.

[Influenza: one dose annually.](flu-seasonal-influenza)

Measles, mumps, and rubella *CONTRAINDICATED*.

[Meningococcal A, C, W and Y: indicated in asplenia, HIV, complement deficiency](meningococcal-conjugate-vaccine-information)
or inhibitor use, travel to endemic countries, microbiologists, and college students. Refer to specific immunization recommendations for asplenia and HIV or refer to the Meningococcal A, C, W and Y vaccine information menu below.

[Meningococcal B: Delay until after pregnancy unless at increased risk and](meningococcal-serogroup-b-vaccine-information)
vaccination benefits outweigh potential risks. Refer to Meningococcal B vaccine information menu below.

[Pneumococcal: for those w/additional risk factor or another indication. Refer to](pneumococcal-vaccine-information)
specific immunization recommendations for patients with these indications or refer to the Pneumococcal vaccine information menus below.

Tetanus, diphtheria and pertussis: Tdap booster dose during each pregnancy.

Varicella: *CONTRAINDICATED*.
